title: Messianic Prophecy
description: Hundreds of years before Jesus was born, God's prophets described exactly what the promised Messiah would be like. Jesus fulfilled every one of them.

waypoints.title: Promised Long Before
waypoints.body: Starting all the way back in the garden, God kept promising a Rescuer. Prophets described where he'd be born, how he'd suffer for others, and what his kingdom would be like -- centuries before it happened.

waypoints.title: Promise and Fulfillment
waypoints.body: Look up one Old Testament prophecy about Jesus and one New Testament verse that shows it came true. Share what you found at dinner.
